normalIntro.en: These memories use the fixed phrases with on and at, the compounds, and the way the word turns into an adjective and a verb.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条利用与 on、at 的固定搭配、复合词，以及这个词转为形容词与动词的路径。

normal.en: Top of is a position, on top of is contact, and the particle changes the picture.
normal.cn: top of 是位置，on top of 是接触，介词改变了画面。

normal.en: Top priority puts the adjective before the noun and means first in importance.
normal.cn: top priority 把形容词放在名词前，意为最重要。

normal.en: From top to bottom goes through a thing completely, from the first layer to the last.
normal.cn: from top to bottom 从第一层到最后一层，指彻底贯穿。

normal.en: Bottle top and pen top both mean the cover, because a cover sits where the top is.
normal.cn: bottle top 与 pen top 都指盖子，因为盖就在顶处。

normal.en: The verb to top means to rise above a figure, as in sales topped a million.
normal.cn: 动词 top 意为高于某个数字，如销量过百万。

abstract.en: Picture a hand flat on the very last rung, with nothing above it but sky.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手按在最后一级横档上，上面只剩天空。

abstract.en: Think of a list where one name sits alone above all the others.
abstract.cn: 想一张名单，有一个名字单独居于所有名字之上。

abstract.en: A top closes a thing, ranks a thing, and beats a thing, and all three come from being highest.
abstract.cn: 顶能封住一物、排出一物、也高过一物，三者都源自「在最上」。

examples.en: There is a bird's nest at the top of the tree.
examples.cn: 树顶有一个鸟巢。

examples.en: The bottle top rolled under the table.
examples.cn: 瓶盖滚到桌子下面去了。

examples.en: The film topped the box office for three weeks.
examples.cn: 这部电影连续三周位居票房榜首。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「托」——顶上要托住，托在最上面的就是 top。

root: 古英语 top（顶巅），另有 topp（头顶发簇）；日耳曼语同源词有古诺斯语 toppr、古高地德语 zopf。由「最高处」引申出盖子、首位、超过等义。

sensesIntro.en: The entry starts from the highest part of a thing, then takes in lids, leading positions, clothing, and finally the adjective and verb that have grown from the same image.
sensesIntro.cn: 条目从物体的最高处写起，继而收进盖子、领先地位、上衣，最后是同一意象长出的形容词与动词用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: the highest point, with nothing above it.
core.cn: 核心意象：最高点，其上再无他物。

branches.en: The highest part and, informally, the head.
branches.cn: 最高部分，以及口语中的头顶。

branches.en: The cover and the act of covering.

branches.cn: 领先地位与表示等级的形容词。

branches.en: The garment that goes on top.
Rising above a figure.

definition_zh: 话题；题目；主题；议题
definition_en: the subject of a talk, a piece of writing, or a discussion
core_image: 黑板正中写着一行大字，全班的讨论都围绕它展开
scene: 会议白板上只写了一句话，其余地方都空着，主持人指着它让大家发言。The topic for today's seminar is how cities treat their rivers.
sceneCN: 这里 topic 是讨论的「主题」（第 1 个义项：谈话或写作的主题）；句意为今天研讨会的主题是城市如何对待自己的河流。画面里有白板、一句话和围坐的人。

pos.zh: 名词：（写作或研究的）选题

derivatives.zh: 加复数词尾 -s，义为「多个话题」
加 -al 构成，义为「时事性的；当前相关话题的」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「就话题而言；按时事地」
由形容词加 -ity 构成，义为「时事性」

senses.title: The subject of a discussion
senses.definition: the subject that a talk, an article, or a meeting is about
senses.definitionCN: 谈话、文章或会议所围绕的主题
senses.example: The speaker changed the topic when the questions became personal.
senses.exampleCN: 问题一涉及私事，讲者就换了话题。
senses.why: The word names the ground the whole exchange stands on, so to change it is to move to different ground.
senses.whyCN: 这个词指整场交流所立足的那块地，换掉它就是移到另一块地上。

senses.title: A subject for writing
senses.definition: a subject chosen for an essay, a report, or a piece of research
senses.definitionCN: 为论文、报告或研究所选的主题
senses.example: Her topic was the effect of noise on birds in the city.
senses.exampleCN: 她的选题是噪音对城市鸟类的影响。
senses.why: A writer must choose one place among many, and that chosen place is called a topic.
senses.whyCN: 写作者要从许多地方里选出其一，而选定的那一处就叫 topic。

senses.title: A heading in a list
senses.definition: one of the items or headings into which a course or a list is divided
senses.definitionCN: 课程或清单划分出的一个条目
senses.example: The course covers twelve topics, from soil to water quality.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课涵盖十二个主题，从土壤到水质。
senses.why: When a course is divided, each division gets a heading, and each heading inherits the name of a place of argument.
senses.whyCN: 课程被切分时，每一块都有一个标题，而每个标题都继承了「论证所在」这个名字。

senses.title: A subject of public interest
senses.definition: a matter that many people are discussing at present
senses.definitionCN: 当前许多人都在谈论的事情
senses.example: A place becomes crowded when everyone gathers there, so a hot topic is literally a crowded place of talk.
senses.exampleCN: 当所有人聚到一处，那个地方就拥挤起来，所以热门话题字面上是谈话拥挤之地。
senses.why: Once the Greek place word became a subject word, any subject people crowd around could be called hot.
senses.whyCN: 一旦那个希腊「地方」之词变成了「主题」之词，任何众人聚拢的主题都能被称作 hot。

senses.title: A separate matter on the table
senses.definition: one distinct item for decision among several
senses.definitionCN: 若干待决事项中独立的一项
senses.example: Housing is the first topic on the agenda tonight.
senses.exampleCN: 住房是今晚议程上的第一项议题。
senses.why: An agenda is a row of places to visit, and each one is a topic.
senses.whyCN: 议程是一串要依次到访的地点，每一处都是一个 topic。

senses.title: The subject of a study
senses.definition: the central subject around which a study or an investigation is built
senses.definitionCN: 一项研究或调查所围绕的中心主题
senses.example: Choosing a narrow topic makes the reading manageable.
senses.exampleCN: 把主题选窄，阅读量就变得可控。
senses.why: Research needs a single ground that can be covered, so the word means the chosen field of a study.
senses.whyCN: 研究需要一块能走完的地面，所以这个词也指一项研究所选定的领域。

senses.title: A conversation opener
senses.definition: a light subject used to begin a conversation
senses.definitionCN: 用来开始交谈的轻松话题
senses.example: Weather is the safest topic with strangers.
senses.exampleCN: 和陌生人聊天，天气是最安全的话题。
senses.why: A safe topic is neutral ground where neither speaker risks an argument.
senses.whyCN: 安全的话题是中立的地面，双方在那儿都不会引发争执。

senses.title: A topic in a text
senses.definition: the subject a passage is organised around, often named in a topic sentence
senses.definitionCN: 一段文字所组织的主题，常由主题句点明
senses.example: The topic of the paragraph is announced in its first sentence.
senses.exampleCN: 这一段的话题由它的第一句点明。
senses.why: A paragraph must announce its ground before building on it, and that announcing sentence takes the name of the word.
senses.whyCN: 一段文字必须先声明它立足的地面，再在其上建构，这个声明句就用了本词之名。

intro.en: Topic comes from the Greek word for place, topika, used of the places of argument in Aristotle's logic; English extended the word from the headings of an argument to any subject.
intro.cn: topic 来自希腊语中表示「地方」的 topika，原指亚里士多德逻辑里论证的「所在」；英语把它从论证的条目扩展到任何主题。

items.en: Topos means a place, and ta topika are the places or common headings from which arguments are drawn.
items.cn: 希腊语 topos 意为地方，ta topika 指抽取论证的「所在」或通用条目。

items.en: Latin topica names the same collection of argument headings, and the word enters learned Latin as a title.
items.cn: 拉丁语 topica 指同一套论证条目，作为书名进入学术拉丁语。

items.en: Old French topic descends from the Latin title and is used of a general heading of thought.
items.cn: 古法语 topic 源自这一拉丁书名，用于表示一般性的思想条目。

items.en: English takes topic in the sixteenth century for a common heading of argument, then for any subject.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 topic，先指论证的常用条目，后指任何主题。

items.en: By the eighteenth century the modern sense of the subject of a talk is ordinary.
items.cn: 到十八世纪，「谈话主题」这一现代义项已很平常。

items.en: Topical and topically grow from it to mean what is currently discussed or locally applied.
items.cn: topical 与 topically 由它派生，意为当前所讨论的，或局部施用的。

note.en: The look-alike group collects derivatives of the same stem, while the near-meaning group gathers words for subject, argument, and the point under discussion.
note.cn: 形近组收集同一词干的派生词，近义组则汇集表示主题、论点与讨论焦点的词。

the plural of the word
a round root vegetable

entries.definition: a latitude line, or the tropical region

a matter that people argue about

normalIntro.en: These memories start from the Greek word for place, then use the fixed phrases of discussion and writing.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从希腊语中表示「地方」的词说起，再利用讨论与写作的固定搭配。

normal.en: The Greek topos means a place, so a topic is the ground a discussion stands on.
normal.cn: 希腊语里的 topos 就是「地方」，所以 topic 是讨论所立足的地面。

normal.en: Change the topic means to leave that ground and step onto another.
normal.cn: change the topic 意为离开那块地，踏到另一块上。

normal.en: A topic sentence announces the ground of a paragraph in its first line.
normal.cn: topic sentence 在第一行就点明一段的地面。

normal.en: Topical news is news about what people are discussing now.
normal.cn: topical news 就是关于人们当下议论之事的新闻。

normal.en: On the topic of is the formal bridge into a subject.
normal.cn: on the topic of 是正式引入某个主题的桥。

abstract.en: Picture a single line of chalk on a blackboard with the whole class facing it.
abstract.cn: 想象黑板上一行粉笔字，全班都朝着它。

abstract.en: Think of a table where one card has been laid face up and the rest are still covered.
abstract.cn: 想一张桌子，一张牌已翻开，其余还盖着。

abstract.en: A topic is a place people can stand together, which is why the old word was simply a place.
abstract.cn: 话题是人们可以一起站的地方，所以那个古词本来就是「地方」。

examples.en: Let us return to the topic of the budget.
examples.cn: 让我们回到预算这个话题。

examples.en: Climate change is a hot topic among students this year.
examples.cn: 气候变化今年在学生中是个热门话题。

examples.en: The first sentence of the paragraph states the topic clearly.
examples.cn: 这一段的第一句清楚地表明了主题。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「托皮克」——托出一个皮克（话题）让大家一起聊。

root: 希腊语 topos（地方）→ ta topika（论证的所在）→ 拉丁语 topica → 古法语 topic → 英语 topic。由「论证条目」扩展为「话题」；同族词 topical。

sensesIntro.en: From a Greek place of argument the word became the subject of a talk, then the choice of a writer, the item on an agenda, and the light opening of a conversation.
sensesIntro.cn: 这个词从希腊语中「论证的所在」变成了谈话的主题，又变成写作者的选题、议程上的一项、以及谈话的轻松切入点。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a place where a discussion stands.
core.cn: 核心意象：讨论所立足的一处地面。

branches.en: What a conversation is about, and how it starts.

branches.cn: 为写作或研究选定的主题。

branches.en: Items into which a course or agenda is divided.
branches.cn: 课程或议程划分出的条目。

branches.cn: 一段文字所组织的主题。

intro.cn: 本词以源自希腊语的 -ic 收尾，英语再加 -al、-ally 与 -ity 构成词族。

definition_zh: 总的；总计的；完全的；全部；总数；合计达
definition_en: the whole amount of something, or complete and entire, or to add up to a figure
core_image: 一长串账单被最后一道横线压住，末尾写着一个整整齐齐的数
scene: 结账时收银条一路打印到纸尾，最下面那一行加粗。The total for the trip came to more than we had planned.
sceneCN: 这里 total 是「总数、总额」（第 4 个义项：所有部分相加之和）；句意为这趟旅行的总额超出了我们的计划。画面里有长条小票、最末那行加粗的数字。

pos.zh: 形容词：总的；全部的；完全的

derivatives.zh: 加 -ly 构成，义为「完全地；全部地」
加 -ity 构成，义为「整体；全部」
加前缀 sub- 构成，义为「小计；部分合计」
由 total 派生的政治术语，义为「极权的」

senses.title: The whole amount
senses.definition: the complete amount obtained by adding all the parts together
senses.definitionCN: 把所有部分相加所得的完整数量
senses.example: The total of the two bills was surprisingly small.
senses.exampleCN: 两张账单的总额小得令人意外。
senses.why: The Latin word for the whole is the direct source, so the noun names the sum in its completeness.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语中表示「整体」的词是直接来源，故名词指完整加总后的量。

senses.title: Adding up to a figure
senses.definition: to amount to a particular figure when all parts are counted
senses.definitionCN: 各部分组成加总起来达到某个数字
senses.example: The costs totalled more than three thousand yuan.
senses.exampleCN: 这些花费合计超过三千元。
senses.why: The noun turns into a verb: to make a total out of scattered items.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为动词：把零散的项加总成一个总数。

senses.title: Complete and absolute
senses.definition: used of something with no part missing or no exception allowed
senses.definitionCN: 用于毫无缺失或毫无例外的情形
senses.example: The room fell into total silence when she began to speak.
senses.exampleCN: 她开口时，屋子里一片死寂。
senses.why: If a total is everything, then a total silence is silence without one sound left out.
senses.whyCN: 既然总数意味着全部，那么 total silence 就是一点声音也没遗漏的静。

senses.title: A sum of money owed
senses.definition: the full sum due for goods or services
senses.definitionCN: 为货物或服务应付的全部款项
senses.example: Please pay the total within seven days of the invoice.
senses.exampleCN: 请在开票后七天内付清总额。
senses.why: Shops print the total at the bottom of a receipt, since it is the last and whole figure.
senses.whyCN: 商店把小票底部的那个数叫作 total，因为它是最后也是完整的那个数。

senses.title: Counting everything in
senses.definition: including every member or part, as in the total number of students
senses.definitionCN: 包括每个成员或每个部分，如学生总人数
senses.example: The total number of students rose by two hundred this year.
senses.exampleCN: 今年学生总人数增加了两百。
senses.why: The adjective marks a count that leaves nothing outside it.
senses.whyCN: 这个形容词标记一种不把任何东西留在外面的计数。

senses.title: A whole in philosophy
senses.definition: in older philosophical writing, the whole made of parts that hang together
senses.definitionCN: 在较早的哲学文字中，指由相联部分构成的整体
senses.example: The old textbook speaks of the total as more than the sum of its parts.
senses.exampleCN: 那本旧教材说整体大于其各部分之和。
senses.why: Philosophy uses the word for any whole that holds together, which is the root idea unextended.
senses.whyCN: 哲学用这个词指任何自成一体的整体，这正是未加引申的词根本义。

senses.title: Complete ruin in expressions
senses.definition: used in phrases such as a total loss to mean damage beyond recovery
senses.definitionCN: 用于 a total loss 等短语，表示彻底损失、无法挽回
senses.example: The storm left the boat a total loss.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴使那条船彻底报废。
senses.why: Insurance language needs a word for damage with nothing left to save, and total supplies it.
senses.whyCN: 保险用语需要一个词表示无可挽回的损毁，total 正好提供。

senses.title: Everything considered
senses.definition: used in phrases like in total or a total of to introduce a final count
senses.definitionCN: 用于 in total 或 a total of 等短语引出最终计数
senses.example: A total of forty people signed the sheet.
senses.exampleCN: 共有四十人在表上签了字。
senses.why: The phrase works like a bracket around a list, closing it with one figure.
senses.whyCN: 这个短语像一对括号把一串项目包起来，再用一个数字收尾。

intro.en: Total comes from medieval Latin totalis, an adjective from totus, the Latin word for whole or entire, and it entered English through French.
intro.cn: total 来自中世纪拉丁语 totalis，是 totus（意为「整个、全部」）的形容词，经由法语进入英语。

items.en: Totus means all, whole, or entire, and it has no parts to be counted separately.
items.cn: 拉丁语 totus 意为「全部、整个」，它本身不再被拆成可数的部分。

items.en: The derived adjective totalis names what belongs to the whole rather than to a part.
items.cn: 由它派生的形容词 totalis 指属于整体而非属于部分的。

items.en: Old French takes total as an adjective of the schools and of accounts.
items.cn: 古法语把 total 用作学校与账目中的形容词。

items.en: Middle English borrows the adjective and soon uses it as a noun for the sum.
items.cn: 中古英语借入这个形容词，很快又把它用作表示总和的名称。

items.en: The verb to total appears in the eighteenth century in bookkeeping and in arithmetic.
items.cn: 动词 total 于十八世纪出现在簿记与算术中。

items.en: The emphatic sense of complete, as in total silence, spreads in the nineteenth and twentieth centuries.
items.cn: 表示「完全」的强调义（如 total silence）在十九、二十世纪扩散开来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers forms on the same stem, while the near-meaning group gathers words for sums and for completeness.
note.cn: 形近组收集同一词干的形式，近义组则汇集表示总和与完整性的词。

the whole of something
the sum of part of a set of figures
to carry something, or a large bag

entries.definition: all of something, with nothing missing
complete, with no part left out

normalIntro.en: These memories use the fixed phrases in total and a total of, the bookkeeping verb, and the emphatic use with abstract nouns.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条利用 in total 与 a total of 的固定搭配、簿记中的动词用法，以及与抽象名词连用时的强调用法。

normal.en: In total and a total of both close a list with one figure.
normal.cn: in total 与 a total of 都用同一个数字为一串项目收尾。

normal.en: A total loss is insurance language, and it means nothing can be saved.
normal.cn: a total loss 是保险用语，意思是无可挽救。

normal.en: The verb is written totalled in British spelling and totaled in American spelling.
normal.cn: 动词在英式拼写中写作 totalled，美式写作 totaled。

normal.en: Total silence means no sound at all, which shows how the word moves from sums to absolutes.
normal.cn: total silence 指一点声音也没有，这显示该词如何从加总走向绝对。

normal.en: Subtotal takes the prefix sub- and gives the sum below the main one.
normal.cn: subtotal 加前缀 sub-，给出主总额之下的那个小计。

abstract.en: Picture a column of figures and a single line ruled under the last of them.
abstract.cn: 想象一列数字，最后一行下面划着一道横线。

abstract.en: Think of an empty room where even the echo has stopped.
abstract.cn: 想一间空房，连回声都停了。

abstract.en: A total leaves nothing outside it, whether it counts money or measures silence.
abstract.cn: 总数不把任何东西留在外面，无论它数的是钱，还是衡量的是静。

examples.en: In total, the project took eleven months to finish.
examples.cn: 这个项目总共用了十一个月才完成。

examples.en: He was in total agreement with the plan.
examples.cn: 他完全同意这个计划。

examples.en: The company's sales totalled nearly two million units last year.
examples.cn: 去年公司的销量合计接近两百万台。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「头托」——把所有数一起托到头上，就是总数 total。

root: 拉丁语 totus（全部、整个）→ 中世纪拉丁语 totalis → 古法语 total → 英语 total。同族词有 totality、subtotal；totus 还与 totidem（同样多）同源。

sensesIntro.en: The entry begins with the added-up sum, then follows the same whole into the verbs of counting, the adjective of completeness, and the emphatic phrases of absolute loss or silence.
sensesIntro.cn: 条目从加总求和开始，再沿「整体」这一概念走入计数的动词、表示完整的形容词，以及「彻底损失」「彻底寂静」这类强调短语。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a whole closed by a ruled line.
core.cn: 核心意象：被一道横线封住的整体。

branches.en: The sum itself and the phrases that present it.
branches.cn: 总和本身以及呈现它的短语。

branches.en: The act of adding parts into a figure.
branches.cn: 把各部分加成一个数字的动作。

branches.en: Completeness and the total count.
The philosophical whole.
Total loss as damage with nothing left.
branches.cn: 彻底损失指无可挽回的损毁。

intro.en: The word is a Latin adjective used as noun, verb, and adjective; its family comes from -ly, -ity, and the prefix sub-.
intro.cn: 本词是兼作名词、动词与形容词的拉丁源形容词，其词族来自 -ly、-ity 与前缀 sub-。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries give totus and the words formed beside it.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁词条给出 totus 及其旁生的词。

items.exampleCN: totally 意为以完全的方式。

items.example: Totality is the state of being whole.
A subtotal is a sum below the main one.
items.exampleCN: subtotal 是主总额之下的小计。

items.example: Totalled is the bookkeeping form.
Totalling the column took a minute.
items.exampleCN: 把那一列加总用了一分钟。

items.example: Totals serves both uses.

definition_zh: 触摸；接触；触觉；少量；联系；感动；涉及
definition_en: to put a hand or an object lightly against something, or the act and sense of such contact
core_image: 指尖轻轻碰到冰凉的玻璃，只留下一圈几乎看不见的雾
scene: 展厅里隔着护栏，讲解员举起手示意不许靠近。Please do not touch the paintings on the wall.
sceneCN: 这里 touch 是动词「触摸、碰」（第 1 个义项：用手或物体轻触某物）；句意为请不要触摸墙上的画。画面里有护栏、伸出的手与墙上的画框。

pos.zh: 动词：触摸；碰到；感动；涉及
名词：触摸；触觉；少量；联系

derivatives.zh: 加 -ing 构成，义为「动人的；感人的」
加 -ed 构成，义为「感动的；有点疯的（口语）」
加否定前缀 un- 构成，义为「未触动过的；未受影响的」
拉丁同源形容词，义为「触觉的」

senses.title: To put a hand on something
senses.definition: to put a hand or finger on something, especially lightly
senses.definitionCN: 用手或手指轻放在某物上，尤指轻轻地
senses.example: She touched the cold glass to feel where the crack began.
senses.exampleCN: 她摸着冰凉的玻璃，想找出裂纹从何处开始。
senses.why: The French verb tocher gave English a word for the light contact of one thing on another.
senses.whyCN: 古法语动词 tocher 为英语提供了表示一物与另一物轻触的词。

senses.title: An act of contact
senses.definition: the state or act of two things being in contact
senses.definitionCN: 两物相互接触的状态或动作
senses.example: A single touch of the wire set off the alarm.
senses.exampleCN: 电线被碰了一下，警报就响了。
senses.why: The verb and the noun are the same idea seen from two sides, one as action and one as event.
senses.whyCN: 动词与名词是同一概念的两面，一为动作，一为事件。

senses.title: The sense of feeling
senses.definition: the ability of the skin to feel what comes against it
senses.definitionCN: 皮肤感知接触物的能力
senses.example: After the accident he lost the touch in two fingers.
senses.exampleCN: 事故之后他两根手指失去了触觉。
senses.why: Among the five senses, touch is the one that works only by direct contact, which is why the word names it.
senses.whyCN: 五官之中，触觉是唯一靠直接接触起作用的，这个词正因此用来命名它。

senses.title: A small amount
senses.definition: a very small quantity of something, often added to a dish or a colour
senses.definitionCN: 极少的一点，常指添进菜肴或颜色的部分
senses.example: Add a touch of salt to the soup before serving.
senses.exampleCN: 上桌前在汤里加一点盐。
senses.why: A small amount is like a fingertip of something, just enough to be felt but not taken in bulk.
senses.whyCN: 少量就像指尖沾到的那一点，感觉得到，却谈不上分量。

senses.title: Contact between people
senses.definition: the state of communicating with someone, as in keep in touch
senses.definitionCN: 与人保持交流的状态，如 keep in touch
senses.example: We stayed in touch after we left the same school.
senses.exampleCN: 离开同一所学校后我们一直保持联系。
senses.why: People who correspond are in contact even at a distance, so the physical word carries over to communication.
senses.whyCN: 保持来往的人即便相隔也处于「接触」中，于是物理的词被挪用到交流上。

senses.title: To move someone deeply
senses.definition: to cause a strong feeling of sympathy or gratitude
senses.definitionCN: 引起强烈的同情或感激之情
senses.example: The letter from her old teacher touched her more than any gift.
senses.exampleCN: 老教师的那封信比任何礼物都让她感动。
senses.why: A feeling is said to reach the heart as a hand reaches the skin, so being moved is being touched.
senses.whyCN: 情感像手触到皮肤那样抵达心里，所以被感动就是被 touch 到。

senses.title: To deal with a subject
senses.definition: to mention or deal with a matter briefly
senses.definitionCN: 简短地提到或处理某个问题
senses.example: The report touches on housing but says little about cost.
senses.exampleCN: 报告谈及住房，却很少提到成本。
senses.why: To touch a subject is to come into contact with it lightly, without taking it up fully.
senses.whyCN: touch 一个话题就是轻轻碰到它，并不把它完全展开。

senses.title: A slight trace of a quality
senses.definition: a slight trace of a quality, as in a touch of sadness
senses.definitionCN: 某种特质的一丝痕迹，如 a touch of sadness
senses.example: There was a touch of frost on the windows this morning.
senses.exampleCN: 今早窗上有一层薄霜。
senses.why: The sense of a small quantity extends from food to weather and to mood, wherever a trace can be noticed.
senses.whyCN: 「少量」义从食物扩展到天气与心情，凡是能察觉出痕迹的地方都能用。

senses.title: Skill with the hands
senses.definition: a special skill in handling something, as in the common touch or a fine touch
senses.definitionCN: 处理某物时的特别本领，如 the common touch 或 a fine touch
senses.example: The old cook still had a fine touch with pastry.
senses.exampleCN: 那位老厨子做起酥点来仍然手法精到。
senses.why: Skill shows in how the hand meets the material, so a good worker is said to have a good touch.
senses.whyCN: 手艺体现在手与材料相接的方式上，所以好手艺被说成有好的 touch。

senses.title: In football and rugby
senses.definition: in rugby and some other games, the area at the side of the field, or the act of grounding the ball
senses.definitionCN: 在橄榄球等运动中指场边区域，或把球触地的动作
senses.example: The ball went into touch and the line-out followed.
senses.exampleCN: 球出了边线，随后进行边线掷球。
senses.why: The sporting use keeps the literal sense: the ball leaves the field by touching the boundary.
senses.whyCN: 体育用法保留了字面义：球碰到边线而离开场地。

intro.en: Touch comes from Old French tochier, from a Vulgar Latin verb built on a root meaning to knock or strike, and it has been used for both contact and feeling since the Middle Ages.
intro.cn: touch 来自古法语 tochier，其源是表示「敲、击」词根的通俗拉丁语动词；自中世纪以来既指接触，也指感受。

items.en: A Vulgar Latin verb related to toccare means to knock or strike lightly against something.
items.cn: 与 toccare 相关的通俗拉丁语动词意为轻敲或轻击某物。

items.en: Old French tochier carries the senses of touching, tasting, and trying.
items.cn: 古法语 tochier 兼有触摸、品尝与尝试诸义。

items.en: Middle English touchen appears in the thirteenth century for physical contact.
items.cn: 中古英语 touchen 在十三世纪出现，表示身体上的接触。

items.en: The sense of moving the feelings is recorded early, since the heart was thought to be struck by emotion.
items.cn: 「感动」义很早就有了，因为当时认为情感会击中心。

items.en: The phrase keep in touch grows out of the older idea of hands meeting in greeting.
items.cn: keep in touch 这一说法源自更早的「以手相握致意」的想法。

items.en: Touch screens and touch typing make the word name any contact used to give a command.
items.cn: 触摸屏与盲打让这个词指任何用来下达指令的接触。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers derivative and compound forms, while the near-meaning group gathers verbs for contact and for feeling.
note.cn: 形近组收集派生与复合形式，近义组则汇集表示接触与感受的动词。

entries.definition: moving the feelings
affected with gratitude or sympathy
not touched or not affected
entries.definitionCN: 未被触碰的；未受影响的

entries.definition: a burning light carried in the hand
entries.definitionCN: 火把；手电，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to sense by touching or in the mind
the state of touching or communicating
to move a hand gently along something
to cause a strong feeling in someone

normalIntro.en: These memories use the fixed phrase in touch, the quantity sense with of, and the way a physical verb grows into a word for feeling.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条利用 in touch 的固定说法、a touch of 的数量用法，以及一个物理动词长成情感词的路径。

normal.en: Keep in touch is about writing and calling, not about hands.
normal.cn: keep in touch 说的是写信打电话，与手无关。

normal.en: A touch of salt and a touch of frost both mean a very small amount.
normal.cn: a touch of salt 与 a touch of frost 都指极少的一点。

normal.en: Touch on a subject means to mention it lightly, never to treat it fully.
normal.cn: touch on a subject 指轻轻提到，从不彻底处理。

normal.en: In rugby, the ball goes into touch when it crosses the side line.
normal.cn: 在橄榄球中，球越过边线就叫出 touch。

normal.en: The adjective touching keeps the feeling sense: a touching story moves you.
normal.cn: 形容词 touching 保留感受义：a touching story 让你感动。

abstract.en: Picture a fingertip on cold glass and the faint print it leaves.
abstract.cn: 想象指尖按在冰凉的玻璃上，留下淡淡的印。

abstract.en: Think of two wires just meeting, and the whole machine starting up.
abstract.cn: 想两根线刚刚接上，整台机器就启动了。

abstract.en: One light contact is enough to carry either information or feeling.
abstract.cn: 轻轻一次接触，就足以传递信息，也足以传递情感。

examples.en: Do not touch the wet paint on the bench.
examples.cn: 别碰长椅上还没干的油漆。

examples.en: We lost touch for years and then met again at a wedding.
examples.cn: 我们失联多年，后来在一场婚礼上重逢。

examples.en: Her speech touched everyone in the hall.
examples.cn: 她的演讲感动了礼堂里的每一个人。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「踏实」——手指一碰到就踏实了，能碰到才算真。

root: 通俗拉丁语 toccare（轻敲）→ 古法语 tochier → 中古英语 touchen → 现代 touch。同族词有 touching、untouched；拉丁词根亦见 tactile「触觉的」。

sensesIntro.en: The entry starts from the light contact of the hand, then takes in the sense of feeling, a small amount, human contact, being moved, and finally the technical uses in talk and in sport.
sensesIntro.cn: 条目从手的轻触写起，再收进触觉、少量、人际往来、感动，最后是谈话与体育中的专门用法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a fingertip meeting a surface.
core.cn: 核心意象：指尖与表面相接。

branches.en: Contact, the act of contact, and the sense that reads it.
branches.cn: 接触、接触的动作与读取它的触觉。

branches.en: A small quantity and a trace of a quality.
branches.cn: 少量与某种特质的一丝痕迹。

branches.en: Keeping in touch and touching on a subject.
branches.cn: 保持联系与谈及某个话题。

branches.en: Being moved by feeling.
Skill of hand, and the touch line in sport.
branches.cn: 手上的技巧与体育中的边线。

intro.en: The word is a borrowed verb that also works as a noun; its family grows with -ing, -ed, un-, and compounds with screen and down.
intro.cn: 本词是兼作名词的借入动词，其词族靠 -ing、-ed、un- 以及与 screen、down 等合成扩展。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries give the root of knocking and its tactile relatives.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁词条给出「敲击」词根及其触觉相关的同族词。

items.example: The stem comes from Old French.
Toccare underlies the Romance forms.
items.exampleCN: toccare 是罗曼语诸形式的基础。

Touching means moving.
Touched means affected.
Untouched means not touched.
Touchable surfaces can be handled.
A touch screen needs a finger.
A touch down is worth five points.

definition_zh: 旅行；参观；巡回演出；任职期；游览；巡回
definition_en: a journey in which several places are visited, or a period of duty in one place, or to travel around an area
core_image: 一辆大巴绕过广场，游客的目光顺着窗外的环形路线转了一圈
scene: 天刚亮，旅店门口就停下一辆白色大巴，导游举着小旗。We took a guided tour of the old town and finished at the harbour.
sceneCN: 这里 tour 是名词「游览、参观」（第 2 个义项：由导游带领的短程参观）；句意为我们跟着导游游览了老城，最后在港口结束。画面里有清晨的大巴、小旗与老城的石街。

pos.zh: 名词：旅行；游览；巡回演出；任期
动词：旅行；巡回（演出、访问）

derivatives.zh: 加 -ism 构成，义为「旅游业」
加 -ist 构成，义为「旅游者；游客」
加 -ing 构成，义为「巡回的；用于旅行的」
加前缀 de- 构成，义为「绕道；弯路」

senses.title: A journey through places
senses.definition: a journey visiting several places one after another
senses.definitionCN: 依次造访若干地方的旅行
senses.example: The band spent two years on a world tour.
senses.exampleCN: 乐队花了两年时间做世界巡演。
senses.why: The Latin and French word for a turn gives the idea of going round a set of places and returning.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语与法语中表示「转」的词带来了绕行一圈再回来的概念。

senses.title: A short visit with a guide
senses.definition: a short organised visit to a place, often with a guide
senses.definitionCN: 由人带领下对某处的短程参观
senses.example: The guided tour lasts about an hour.
senses.exampleCN: 这次有导游的参观大约一小时。
senses.why: A short circuit of a building or a town is a mini version of a long journey, so the same word serves.
senses.whyCN: 绕建筑或城镇走一圈是长途旅行的缩小版，于是同一个词也就够用了。

senses.title: A series of performances
senses.definition: a series of public performances or appearances in different places
senses.definitionCN: 在不同地点连续进行的演出或露面
senses.example: The play goes on tour in the autumn.
senses.exampleCN: 这部戏秋天开始巡回上演。
senses.why: Performers who travel from town to town follow a circuit, which is exactly a tour.
senses.whyCN: 艺人逐城而行正是走一条环线，那恰好就是 tour。

senses.title: A period of duty abroad
senses.definition: a fixed period of service in one place, especially abroad or in the army
senses.definitionCN: 在某地（尤指海外或军中）的一段固定服役期
senses.example: He completed a two-year tour in the north.
senses.exampleCN: 他在北方完成了两年任期。
senses.why: A period assigned in one post resembles a round of duty that ends and returns, and soldiers borrowed the word for it.
senses.whyCN: 派在一处的一段时期像一趟有始有终的差事，军人便借用了这个词。

senses.title: To travel around
senses.definition: to travel through an area or a country, visiting several places
senses.definitionCN: 在某一地区或国家往来游览多处
senses.example: They toured the coast by train last summer.
senses.exampleCN: 去年夏天他们坐火车游了沿海一带。
senses.why: The noun turns into a verb of going round, with the same image of a circle of visits.
senses.whyCN: 名词转为表示绕行的动词，仍是同一圈造访的意象。

senses.title: To take a visitor round
senses.definition: to show a person or a group round a place
senses.definitionCN: 带某人或某团体参观某处
senses.example: An old student toured us round the laboratories.
senses.exampleCN: 一位老学生带我们参观了实验室。
senses.why: Showing someone round is performing a tour for them, so the verb takes a person or a place as its object.
senses.whyCN: 带人参观就是替人做一趟 tour，故动词可接人或地方作宾语。

senses.title: On the road with a show
senses.definition: to go from place to place giving performances or making appearances
senses.definitionCN: 四处奔走演出或露面
senses.example: The singer toured Europe with a small band.
senses.exampleCN: 那位歌手带着一支小乐队巡演欧洲。
senses.why: This use fixes the word in the entertainment world, where the circuit of cities is a regular route.
senses.whyCN: 这一用法把词固定在演艺界，那里城市之间连成固定线路。

senses.title: A turn in older usage
senses.definition: in older texts, a turn or a circular movement
senses.definitionCN: 较早文本中表示一转或环形运动
senses.example: The old clock's tour of the dial took a full day.
senses.exampleCN: 那座旧钟的指针绕表盘一周要一整天。
senses.why: The oldest sense is simply a turn, and every later sense is a journey that comes back to its start.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的义项就是「一转」，后来所有义项都是回到起点的行程。

intro.en: Tour goes back to Latin tornare, to turn on a lathe, and through Old French tour, a turn, to the modern sense of a circular journey.
intro.cn: tour 可上溯到拉丁语 tornare（在车床上转），经古法语 tour（一转）而到现代表示环行旅程的意思。

items.en: Tornare means to turn or to make round, and tornus names a lathe.
items.cn: 拉丁语 tornare 意为转动、使成圆形，tornus 指车床。

items.en: Tornus itself comes from Greek tornos, a tool for drawing circles.
items.cn: tornus 本身来自希腊语 tornos，一种画圆的工具。

items.en: Old French tour means a turn, a circuit, or a round of duty.
items.cn: 古法语 tour 意为回转、一圈或一轮差事。

items.en: Middle English borrows tour for a journey that goes round and returns.
items.cn: 中古英语借入 tour，指绕行一圈再回来的行程。

items.en: The performing tour appears in the eighteenth century as companies travel between towns.
items.cn: 巡回演出之义于十八世纪出现，因为剧团在城镇间往来。

items.en: Tourism and tourist are coined in the early nineteenth century from the same stem.
items.cn: tourism 与 tourist 于十九世纪初由同一词干造出。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words on the same stem, while the near-meaning group gathers words for journeys and visits.
note.cn: 形近组收集同一词干上的词，近义组则汇集表示旅行与参观的词。

entries.definition: a person travelling for pleasure
the business of holidays and travel
a longer way round
a tall narrow building
entries.definitionCN: 塔，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: an act of travelling from one place to another
a short visit to a place and back
a short group journey for pleasure
a long journey by sea or in space

normalIntro.en: These memories use the fixed phrases on tour and a tour of, the compounds with guide and package, and the way the word marks a circle.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条利用 on tour 与 a tour of 的固定搭配、与 guide、package 构成的复合词，以及这个词的「一圈」意味。

normal.en: On tour describes a performer or a team, while on a tour describes a traveller.
normal.cn: on tour 指艺人或球队，on a tour 指旅行者。

normal.en: Tour guide and tour operator both put tour before the noun it describes.
normal.cn: tour guide 与 tour operator 都把 tour 放在所修饰名词之前。

normal.en: A package tour bundles travel, hotel, and food into one price.
normal.cn: a package tour 把交通、住宿与餐食打包成一个价钱。

normal.en: Tourist and tourism add -ist and -ism to the same stem.
normal.cn: tourist 与 tourism 是同一词干加 -ist 与 -ism。

normal.en: Detour takes the prefix de- and means a turn away from the direct road.
normal.cn: detour 加前缀 de-，意为偏离直路的绕行。

abstract.en: Picture a bus circling a square and coming back to the same corner.
abstract.cn: 想象一辆大巴绕广场一圈，又回到同一个街角。

abstract.en: Think of a clock hand sweeping the whole dial and ending where it began.
abstract.cn: 想钟表的指针扫过整个表盘，最后回到起点。

abstract.en: A tour is a turn made large: the same returning shape, drawn across places instead of minutes.
abstract.cn: 旅行是放大的「一转」：同样的回环之形，只是画在地点上而非时间上。

examples.en: The orchestra is on tour in Asia for six weeks.
examples.cn: 乐团正在亚洲巡演六周。

examples.en: She gave us a tour of the new library.
examples.cn: 她带我们参观了新图书馆。

examples.en: We toured the island by bicycle in four days.
examples.cn: 我们用四天骑自行车环游了这座岛。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「图」——出门前先摊开一张地图，画个圈就是 tour。

root: 拉丁语 tornare（转）→ 拉丁语 tornus（车床）→ 古法语 tour（一转、一圈）→ 英语 tour。同族词有 tourist、tourism、detour；拉丁 tornare 亦生出 turn 与之同源。

sensesIntro.en: The entry begins with the journey round several places, then reduces it to a short guided visit, widens it to a series of performances and to a term of duty, and closes with the verb and the old sense of a single turn.
sensesIntro.cn: 条目从周游数地的旅程写起，再缩小为有导游的短程参观，扩大到巡回演出与海外任期，最后收在动词用法与「一转」这一古老义项上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a circle of visits that returns to the start.
core.cn: 核心意象：绕行一圈又回到原处的造访。

branches.en: The long journey and the old sense of a turn.
branches.cn: 长途旅行与古老的「一转」义。

branches.en: A short guided visit and the act of showing round.
branches.cn: 短程参观与带人参观的动作。

branches.en: Concerts on the road and touring with a show.
A fixed period of service abroad.
Travelling around an area.

intro.en: The word is a short borrowed stem; its family comes from -ist, -ism, -ing, and the prefix de-.
intro.cn: 本词是简短的借入词干，其词族来自 -ist、-ism、-ing 与前缀 de-。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries give the root of turning and the words built on it.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁词条给出「转」的词根及其构成的词。

items.example: The English form drops the final vowel sound.
items.exampleCN: 英语形式丢了末尾的元音。

items.example: Tornare is the ultimate source.
Tornus gives the root image of turning.
items.exampleCN: tornus 给出「转」的核心意象。

items.example: A tourist travels for pleasure.
items.exampleCN: tourist 是为游乐而旅行的人。

items.example: Tourism is the trade of travel.
Touring means travelling on a circuit.
A detour turns away from the road.
Toured is the past tense.
Tours serves both uses.

definition_zh: 毛巾；手巾；浴巾；纸巾
definition_en: a piece of thick cloth used for drying your body, hands, or dishes
core_image: 一条搭在木架上、还在滴水的厚布
scene: 洗完手之后水还在往下淌，架子上的厚布被拿起来按在掌心。He reached for the towel and wiped his hands twice.
sceneCN: 这里 towel 是「毛巾、手巾」（第 1 个义项：用于擦干身体或手的一块厚布）；句意为他拿起毛巾把手擦了两遍。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「毛巾布；毛巾料」
由过去分词转化，义为「用毛巾擦干的」

senses.title: Cloth for drying the hands or face
senses.definition: a small thick cloth kept by a basin for wiping wet hands or face
senses.definitionCN: 放在盆边用来擦干湿手或脸的小块厚布
senses.example: There is a clean towel hanging beside the sink.
senses.exampleCN: 水槽旁边挂着一条干净的毛巾。
senses.why: The word names the cloth that does the drying, and this household use is the oldest everyday sense.
senses.whyCN: 这个词本指执行擦干动作的那块布，这种家常用途是最古老的日常义项。

senses.title: The large cloth used after a bath
senses.definition: a big towel that wraps the whole body after washing
senses.definitionCN: 洗完澡后能裹住整个身体的大毛巾
senses.example: She came out of the shower wrapped in a towel.
senses.exampleCN: 她裹着浴巾从淋浴间走出来。
senses.why: The same cloth grows to body size, and English simply keeps the one word for both sizes.
senses.whyCN: 同一种布长大到身体尺寸，英语仍用一个词兼指两种规格。

senses.title: A disposable paper square
senses.definition: a sheet of absorbent paper used once for drying or wiping
senses.definitionCN: 一次性使用、用来擦干的吸水纸
senses.example: He grabbed a paper towel to mop up the spilled coffee.
senses.exampleCN: 他抽了一张纸巾去擦洒出来的咖啡。
senses.why: When paper took over the drying job, the old cloth name simply moved onto it with paper in front.
senses.whyCN: 当纸接过擦干的任务，旧的布名只要前面加个 paper 就直接移用过去了。

senses.title: To rub dry with a towel
senses.definition: to rub a person, animal, or object dry with a towel
senses.definitionCN: 用毛巾把人、动物或物体擦干
senses.example: She toweled her hair quickly and ran for the bus.
senses.exampleCN: 她匆匆把头发擦干就往公交站跑。
senses.why: Any tool can be turned into a verb, so the cloth becomes the action of using it.
senses.whyCN: 任何工具都能转为动词，于是这块布就成了「用它」这个动作。

senses.title: Surrender in the idiom
senses.definition: in the phrase throw in the towel, to admit defeat and stop trying
senses.definitionCN: 在短语 throw in the towel 中表示承认失败、停止努力
senses.example: After three failed attempts he threw in the towel.
senses.exampleCN: 三次尝试失败后，他认输了。
senses.why: A boxer's corner threw a towel into the ring to end the fight, so the cloth came to mean giving up.
senses.whyCN: 拳击台的教练往擂台上扔毛巾表示终止比赛，于是这条布就成了「放弃」的意思。

intro.en: Towel comes from Old French toaille, a cloth for washing, which goes back to a Germanic word for a washing cloth, probably influenced in form by Latin words for cloth.
intro.cn: towel 来自古法语 toaille（洗涤用的布），其更早来源是日耳曼语表示「擦洗布」的词，词形大概受拉丁语中表示布的词影响。

items.en: A Germanic word for a washing cloth, related to the verb to wash, is generally taken as the ultimate source.
items.cn: 一般认为其最终来源是日耳曼语中表示「洗涤布」的词，与表示「洗」的动词相关。

items.en: Frankish speech carries the word into Old French, where it appears as toaille with the meaning bath cloth.
items.cn: 法兰克人的语言把这个词带进古法语，写成 toaille，意为「浴布」。

items.en: Medieval Latin documents use toallia and tuallia for table and hand cloths, likely borrowed back from the French form.
items.cn: 中世纪拉丁文献用 toallia、tuallia 指桌布和擦手布，大概又是从法语形式借回去的。

items.en: English adopts the word as towaille and later settles on towel for the cloth kept by the basin.
items.cn: 英语先写成 towaille，后来固定为 towel，指放在盆边的擦布。

items.en: In the nineteenth century the word attaches to paper sheets, and the boxing phrase throw in the towel appears.
items.cn: 十九世纪这个词用到纸制品上，拳击习语 throw in the towel 也在这时出现。

items.en: The verb to towel develops in the same period from the noun, first for people then for dogs and hair.
items.cn: 动词 towel 也在同一时期由名词发展出来，先指擦人，后指擦狗和头发。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words that share the ending or the towel-like shape, and the near-meaning group gathers cloths used in the bathroom or kitchen.
note.cn: 形近组收集词尾相同或形状像毛巾的词，近义组则收入浴室与厨房用的布。

soft cloth used for washing the face
a cloth or paper used at meals
soft paper used for wiping the nose

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the way the word has moved from cloth to paper and from noun to verb.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从本词「由布到纸、由名词到动词」的迁移方式入手。

normal.en: Bath towel, hand towel, paper towel: the material or the use goes in front of the same cloth.
normal.cn: bath towel、hand towel、paper towel，材料或用途一律放在这块布前面。

normal.en: The -el ending is the same as in the borrowed French cloth words, not a suffix of meaning.
normal.cn: 词尾 -el 和借入的法语布名一样，只是形式，不表示意义。

normal.en: Towel can be a verb because every tool can become the act of using it.
normal.cn: towel 可以作动词，因为每件工具都能变成使用它的动作。

normal.en: Throw in the towel comes from boxing corners, where a thrown cloth ended the fight.
normal.cn: throw in the towel 来自拳击教练席，被扔出的布会终止比赛。

normal.en: Paper towel shows the word's willingness to change material: cloth first, paper later.
normal.cn: paper towel 显示这个词乐于更换材质：先是布，后来是纸。

abstract.en: Picture a wet hand and the white square that turns it dry in two seconds.
abstract.cn: 想象一只湿手和那块两秒就把它擦白的方布。

abstract.en: Think of a towel on a rail, still heavy with the last person's water.
abstract.cn: 想一条搭在架上的毛巾，还带着上一位使用者的水。

abstract.en: A towel is a small borrowed dryness that you hand back after use.
abstract.cn: 毛巾是可以借用、用完还回去的一小块「干」。

examples.en: Pass me a towel, please.
examples.cn: 请递给我一条毛巾。

examples.en: He toweled the dog dry at the door.
examples.cn: 他在门口把狗擦干了。

examples.en: After two hours of arguing, she threw in the towel.
examples.cn: 争了两个小时后，她认输了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「套哦」——把手套进去擦干，哦，水全没了。

root: 日耳曼语「擦洗布」（与「洗」的动词相关）→ 法兰克语 → 古法语 toaille → 中古英语 towaille → 英语 towel。同族词有 towelling、toweled。

sensesIntro.en: The entry follows one cloth through its sizes and materials, then through its change from noun to verb, and ends at the boxing ring where the same cloth means defeat.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词跟随同一块布，走过不同尺寸与材质，再由名词转为动词，最后来到拳击台上，用同一块布表示认输。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thick absorbent cloth held against wet skin.
core.cn: 核心意象：一块厚而吸水的布贴在湿皮肤上。

branches.en: The small cloth beside the basin.
The body-sized cloth after a bath.
The paper version of the drying cloth.
The cloth turned into an action.
The thrown cloth that ends a fight.
branches.cn: 被扔出去终止比赛的布。

intro.en: The word is a borrowing without a productive English suffix, but its members show the -el of borrowed French nouns and the -ing of the continuing form.
intro.cn: 本词是借词，没有能产的英语后缀，但词族里能看出法语借入名词的 -el 与持续体的 -ing。

latinIntro.en: Medieval Latin records the word as toallia, borrowed back from French, so the Latin entries are the documentary forms rather than true roots.
latinIntro.cn: 中世纪拉丁文献把这个词记作 toallia，是从法语借回去的，因此下面的拉丁词条是文献形式而非真正词根。

items.example: Toaille is the direct source of the English word.
items.exampleCN: toaille 是英语本词的直接来源。

items.example: The ending appears in borrowed cloth names.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾出现在借入的布名中。

items.example: Towelling is the cloth the towel is made of.
Toweled is the past of the verb.
Bath towel is the large size.
Hand towel is the small size.
Paper towel replaces cloth with sheet.
items.exampleCN: paper towel 用纸片替代布。

items.meaning: a bar to hang things on
items.example: A towel rail holds the cloths.

latinEntries.meaning: a variant form of the same cloth word
latinEntries.meaningCN: 同一布名词的变体形式

definition_zh: 塔；高楼；塔楼；（作动词）高耸；远远高出
definition_en: a tall narrow structure or building that stands far above what is around it
core_image: 一座瘦高的石塔，从周围的屋顶里直插上去
scene: 黄昏的旧城，屋顶一片低矮，只有教堂的石砌高塔越过了所有屋脊。The clock tower can be seen from the harbour on a clear evening.
sceneCN: 这里 tower 是「塔」（第 1 个义项：高而窄的建筑物）；句意为天气晴好的傍晚从港湾就能望见那座钟塔。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「高耸的；极其高大的」
由过去分词转化，义为「有塔楼的」
来自同一拉丁词源的小词，义为「小塔；角楼」

senses.title: A tall narrow structure
senses.definition: a building or structure much taller than it is wide, often used for watching, bells, or water
senses.definitionCN: 高度远大于宽度的建筑或结构，常用于瞭望、敲钟或储水
senses.example: The tower has stood on the hill for six hundred years.
senses.exampleCN: 这座塔已在山上矗立了六百年。
senses.why: The Latin source names a tower, and this is the plain architectural sense still at the centre of the word.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语来源本身就是「塔」，这是这个词至今居中心位置的建筑本义。

senses.title: A high building of many floors
senses.definition: a tall building with many storeys, especially one for offices or flats
senses.definitionCN: 层数很多的建筑，尤指办公楼或住宅
senses.example: They work on the twentieth floor of that tower.
senses.exampleCN: 他们在那座高楼的二十层上班。
senses.why: When cities grew upward, the tall vertical shape of the stone tower was simply reused for new buildings.
senses.whyCN: 当城市向上生长时，石塔那种高而直的形态就被直接套用到新建筑上。

senses.title: To rise far above the surroundings
senses.definition: used of something that stands much taller than the things near it
senses.definitionCN: 指某物比周围的东西高得多
senses.example: The old tree towers over the garden wall.
senses.exampleCN: 那棵老树高过花园的围墙。
senses.why: A building so vertical becomes a gesture, and the noun turns into a verb for standing tall.
senses.whyCN: 建筑如此竖直就变成了一种姿态，名词便转为「站得高」的动词。

senses.title: To be far greater in another quality
senses.definition: to be far greater than someone or something in ability, size, or importance
senses.definitionCN: 在能力、规模或重要性上远远超过某人或某物
senses.example: In debate she towers over her opponents.
senses.exampleCN: 在辩论中她远远胜过对手。
senses.why: Height is the easiest metaphor for excellence, so towering over rivals means being much greater.
senses.whyCN: 「高」是形容卓越最容易的比喻，所以高于对手就是远胜对手。

senses.title: A place of proud distance
senses.definition: in phrases like ivory tower, a protected place far from ordinary life
senses.definitionCN: 如 ivory tower 一类说法中，指远离日常生活的保护区
senses.example: Critics say the scholars have retired to an ivory tower.
senses.exampleCN: 批评者说这些学者退进了象牙塔。
senses.why: A tower keeps its people above the street and away from it, so the image comes to mean proud isolation.
senses.whyCN: 塔让人位于街道之上并与之隔绝，于是这个形象转指高傲的自我隔离。

intro.en: Tower comes from Latin turris through Old French tor, and the same Latin noun gave Greek island towns such as Tower names across Europe; the more distant origin is uncertain.
intro.cn: tower 经古法语 tor 来自拉丁语 turris；更深来源不确定。同一个拉丁名词在整个欧洲派生出了众多塔名。

items.en: Greek tyrris is cited as a forerunner of the Latin word, but the link is debated.
items.cn: 一般认为希腊语 tyrris 是拉丁词的先形，但这层联系仍有争议。

items.en: Latin turris names a tall fortified structure, and it is borrowed by many languages of the empire.
items.cn: 拉丁语 turris 指高耸的防御性建筑，被帝国境内的许多语言借走。

items.en: Old French tor and tur keep the military sense and pass into the language of castles.
items.cn: 古法语 tor、tur 保留了军事含义，进入城堡用语。

items.en: Middle English tower first means a castle keep or a church bell tower.
items.cn: 中古英语 tower 最初指城堡主楼或教堂钟楼。

items.en: In the nineteenth and twentieth centuries the word widens to office blocks and water works.
items.cn: 十九、二十世纪，这个词扩展到办公楼与供水设施。

items.en: The figurative ivory tower becomes common after French criticism of writers in the nineteenth century.
items.cn: 十九世纪法国人批评作家脱离现实之后，比喻性的 ivory tower 才流行起来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words easily confused in spelling with tower, and the near-meaning group gathers tall vertical things.
note.cn: 形近组收集拼写易与 tower 混淆的词，近义组收集高而竖直的事物。

entries.definitionCN: 毛巾，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: to pull a vehicle along
entries.definitionCN: 拖；牵引，只是拼写相近，词源不同

extremely tall

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the Latin stem, from the castle and water compounds, and from the verb of standing tall.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从拉丁词干、城堡与储水的复合词，以及「高耸」的动词用法入手。

normal.en: Turris is the Latin tower, and it stands behind turret as well.
normal.cn: turris 是拉丁语的塔，turret 也由它而来。

normal.en: Clock tower, water tower, tower block: the word sits in front to say what the tall thing is for.
normal.cn: clock tower、water tower、tower block，本词放前面说明这座高物是做什么用的。

normal.en: The verb use is easy: towers over simply means stands much taller than.
normal.cn: 动词用法很简单：towers over 就是「比……高得多地立着」。

normal.en: Ivory tower is a set phrase and its meaning is isolation, not height.
normal.cn: ivory tower 是固定说法，重点在隔离，不在高度。

normal.en: Tower and towel differ by one letter, so remember the tower has an r for rock.
normal.cn: tower 与 towel 只差一个字母，记住塔有 r，r 代表石头。

abstract.en: Picture a thin grey finger of stone poking above a whole town of roofs.
abstract.cn: 想象一根细细的灰色石指，从全城的屋顶上方伸出来。

abstract.en: Think of a shadow that is long at sunset because the thing casting it is so tall.
abstract.cn: 想日落时那道很长的影子，因为投下影子的东西太高了。

abstract.en: A tower is height that has been made permanent.
abstract.cn: 塔是被固定下来的高度。

examples.en: The water tower supplies the whole village.
examples.cn: 这座水塔为整个村子供水。

examples.en: He towers over everyone in his class.
examples.cn: 他比班上所有人都高出一截。

examples.en: The tower was struck by lightning last summer.
examples.cn: 去年夏天这座塔被雷击中了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「塔窝」——塔里有个窝，抬头看塔，越看越高。

root: 拉丁语 turris（塔）→ 古法语 tor → 中古英语 tower。同族或同源词有 turret；更早的希腊语来源一般认为相关，但尚未定论。

sensesIntro.en: From one upright stone shape the entry rises into the modern high building, then tilts into the verb of being taller, then into superiority, and finally into the tower as a place of proud isolation.
sensesIntro.cn: 从一块竖直的石头形态出发，本词长成现代高楼，再倾斜为「更高」的动词，进而表示优越，最后成为高傲隔离之所。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a narrow vertical stone rising above everything around it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一座窄而竖直的石构物，高出周围一切。

branches.en: The fort or bell structure itself.
The modern high building.
The act of standing much higher.
The metaphor of superiority.
The tower as a place apart from the world.
branches.cn: 作为远离尘世之处的塔。

intro.en: The word is a simple borrowing from Latin with no productive English suffix, and its compounds are built by putting the purpose in front.
intro.cn: 本词是直接借入的拉丁词，没有能产的英语后缀，其复合词靠把用途前置来构成。

latinIntro.en: The Latin noun turris is the source of the English word and of its diminutive cousin.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁名词 turris 既是英语本词的来源，也是它的指小近亲的来源。

items.example: The stem gives tower and turret.
items.exampleCN: 这个词干给出 tower 与 turret。

items.meaning: no meaning of its own here
items.example: The French ending becomes -er in English.
items.exampleCN: 法语词尾在英语中变为 -er。

items.example: Turret is a small tower.
Towering means standing tall.
Towered means having towers.
A clock tower holds the town clock.
A water tower holds the supply.
A tower block is a high block of flats.
items.exampleCN: tower block 是高层公寓楼。

items.example: Ivory tower is the phrase of isolation.
items.exampleCN: ivory tower 是表示隔离的说法。

definition_zh: 城镇；市镇；城里；商业中心区
definition_en: a place with many houses, shops, and streets, larger than a village but usually smaller than a city
core_image: 一条街连着一条街，中间有广场和集市的聚集地
scene: 周六早晨，广场上支起了一排卖菜的棚子，熟人和陌生人混在一起走。The whole town turns out for the market on Saturday.
sceneCN: 这里 town 是「城镇」（第 1 个义项：比村庄大、比城市小的人类聚居地）；句意为周六整个镇子的人都出来赶集。

derivatives.zh: 由 town 加 people 构成，义为「镇上居民」
由 town 加 -ship 构成，义为「镇区；乡」
由 town 加 -ie 构成，口语指「镇上人」

senses.title: A settlement larger than a village
senses.definition: a place where many people live and work, with shops and streets, but not as big as a city
senses.definitionCN: 许多人居住和工作的地方，有商店和街道，但不如城市大
senses.example: The town grew slowly around the river crossing.
senses.exampleCN: 这个镇子沿着渡口慢慢长大。
senses.why: The oldest sense is an enclosed settlement, and the fence that once made it a unit still shapes the idea of it.
senses.whyCN: 最古老的含义是有围护的聚居地，那道曾使它成为一体的围墙至今影响着这个概念。

senses.title: The built-up centre as opposed to the countryside
senses.definition: the shopping and business part of a district, seen from the countryside around it
senses.definitionCN: 一个地区的商业与办事区域，相对于周围的乡村而言
senses.example: We drove into town to buy paint and a new lamp.
senses.exampleCN: 我们进城去买油漆和一盏新灯。
senses.why: People living outside mark the centre as their centre, so town becomes a place one goes into rather than a whole place.
senses.whyCN: 住在外面的人把中心当作自己的中心，于是 town 成为「要去的地方」，而不是一整块地方。

senses.title: The people of a town taken together
senses.definition: the inhabitants of a place regarded as one group
senses.definitionCN: 把某地居民视为一个整体
senses.example: The whole town came to see the fire engine.
senses.exampleCN: 全镇的人都来看那辆消防车。
senses.why: A place name can stand for its people, so the word shifts from streets to the crowd on them.
senses.whyCN: 地名可以代表居民，于是这个词从「街道」转到街上的「人群」。

senses.title: The place one belongs to
senses.definition: in phrases like home town, the place where a person grew up
senses.definitionCN: 如 home town 一类说法中，指一个人长大的地方
senses.example: He returned to his home town after twenty years in the navy.
senses.exampleCN: 他在海军待了二十年后回到家乡。
senses.why: Because a town holds a person's early life, it becomes a marker of identity rather than a mere location.
senses.whyCN: 因为镇子承载了一个人的早年生活，它就成了身份的标志，而不只是地点。

senses.title: Urban life as a manner
senses.definition: used before other nouns to describe customs and habits of urban living
senses.definitionCN: 放在其他名词前，描述城市生活的习俗与习惯
senses.example: Town life suited her better than the quiet farms.
senses.exampleCN: 比起安静的农场，城市生活更适合她。
senses.why: The noun in front position turns into a style label, describing a way of living rather than a spot on the map.
senses.whyCN: 名词放在前位就变成风格标签，描述的是一种生活方式，而不是地图上的一点。

intro.en: Town is one of the oldest English words and is related to Dutch tuin, garden, and to German Zaun, fence; it first meant an enclosed place.
intro.cn: town 是英语最古老的词之一，与荷兰语 tuin（园子）、德语 Zaun（篱笆）同源，最初意为「被围起来的地方」。

items.en: Old English tun means an enclosed piece of ground, a farm, or an estate, with a fence around it.
items.cn: 古英语 tun 指一块被围起来的地、农场或庄园，四周围着篱笆。

items.en: The same root gives German Zaun, a fence, and Dutch tuin, a garden, showing that enclosure was the core idea.
items.cn: 同一词根给出德语 Zaun（篱笆）和荷兰语 tuin（园子），可见「围护」是核心概念。

items.en: As settlements grew, tun came to mean a group of houses rather than a single farm.
items.cn: 随着聚居地扩大，tun 从单座农庄转指一群房屋。

items.en: By the later Middle Ages town is the ordinary word for a market settlement with a charter.
items.cn: 到中古后期，town 已成为指有特许状的集市聚居地的常用词。

items.en: From the seventeenth century town is often opposed to country, giving the phrase to go into town.
items.cn: 十七世纪起 town 常与 country 相对，于是有了 to go into town 这样的说法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words confused with town in spelling or sound, and the near-meaning group gathers kinds of settlement.
note.cn: 形近组收集拼写或读音易与 town 混淆的词，近义组收集不同类型的聚居地。

entries.definition: a unit of weight
entries.definitionCN: 吨，只是拼写相近，词源不同

entries.definition: toward a lower place
entries.definitionCN: 向下，只是读音相近，词源不同

entries.definition: a district of a town or a local unit of government
the people who live in a town
a small settlement in the countryside
a very large and important urban place
a residential area on the edge of a city

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the old meaning of an enclosed farm, from the compounds, and from the phrase of going into town.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「围起来的农庄」这一古老含义、复合词以及「进城」的说法入手。

normal.en: Old English tun was a fenced farm, so a town is first of all a place marked off by a boundary.
normal.cn: 古英语 tun 是围起篱笆的农庄，所以镇首先是划出边界的地方。

normal.en: German Zaun and Dutch tuin are cousins, both about enclosure.
normal.cn: 德语 Zaun 与荷兰语 tuin 是近亲，都围绕「围」这个意思。

normal.en: Town hall, town centre, home town: the word likes to stand in front of another noun.
normal.cn: town hall、town centre、home town，这个词喜欢站在另一名词前。

normal.en: Go into town works because the countryside surrounds it, not because the town has an inside.
normal.cn: go into town 成立，是因为乡村包围着它，而不是镇真有内部。

normal.en: The word is short and closed, just like the fence that started it.
normal.cn: 这个词短而封闭，正像最初围着它的那道篱笆。

abstract.en: Picture a fence, then houses inside the fence, then the fence forgotten and the houses still there.
abstract.cn: 想象一道篱笆，篱笆里的房屋，后来篱笆被忘了，房屋还在。

abstract.en: Think of a square where every person knows three others by name but not everyone.
abstract.cn: 想一个广场，每个人能叫出另外三个人的名字，却不是所有人都认识。

abstract.en: A town is a village that got busy, before it became a city that got anonymous.
abstract.cn: 镇是一个忙起来的村庄，还未变成匿名的城市。

examples.en: Our town has one cinema and two bakeries.
examples.cn: 我们镇上有一家电影院和两家面包房。

examples.en: She went into town to post the letters.
examples.cn: 她进城去寄信。

examples.en: The old town is famous for its stone bridge.
examples.cn: 这座老城以石桥闻名。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「趟」——一趟出去逛，街上到处是人，就是镇。

root: 古英语 tun（有篱笆围起的土地、农庄）→ 中古英语 town（一群房屋的聚居地）→ 现代英语 town（城镇）。同源词有德语 Zaun（篱笆）、荷兰语 tuin（园子）。

sensesIntro.en: From an enclosed farm the word grows into a settlement, then into the centre that people go into, then into the people who live there, then into the place a person belongs to, and finally into a style of life.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词从围起的农庄长成聚居地，再成为人们「进去」的中心，再指其中的居民，进而指一个人归属的地方，最后成为一种生活方式。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a ring of fence with houses gathered inside it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一圈篱笆，里面聚着一群房屋。

branches.en: The settlement itself, bigger than a village.
branches.cn: 比村庄更大的聚居地本身。

branches.en: The centre that one travels into.
The inhabitants as one body.
The place that holds one's early life.
branches.cn: 承载一个人早年生活的地方。

branches.en: The urban manner of living.

intro.en: The word is a native English root with no added suffix, and its family is built with -ship, people, and the informal -ie.
intro.cn: 本词是英语本土词根，未加后缀，其词族由 -ship、people 以及口语化的 -ie 构成。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin source for this word, so the Latin entries are empty and only the Germanic relatives are relevant.
latinIntro.cn: 本词没有拉丁语来源，因此不列拉丁词条，只有日耳曼语亲缘词相关。

items.example: Tun is the oldest recorded form.
items.exampleCN: tun 是最早记录的形式。

items.example: Township names a district.
Townspeople are the residents.
Townie is informal for a town person.
items.exampleCN: townie 是镇上人的口语说法。

items.example: A town hall is the civic building.
The town centre is the middle of the place.
Home town marks where one grew up.
items.exampleCN: home town 标明长大的地方。

items.meaning: a place of buying and selling
items.example: A market town grew around trade.
items.exampleCN: 集镇围绕贸易成长起来。

definition_zh: 贸易；交易；行业；手艺；（作动词）交易；从事贸易
definition_en: the activity of buying and selling goods, or a kind of work that needs skill, and to buy and sell or exchange
core_image: 集市上两只手把货物和钱交换过来
scene: 码头边的集市一早开市，盐、布和铁器在不同的摊位上被换来换去。The two ports have traded salt and timber for three hundred years.
sceneCN: 这里 trade 是「贸易」（第 1 个义项：买进卖出的商业活动）；句意为这两个港口三百年来一直进行盐与木材的贸易。

derivatives.zh: 由动词加 -er 构成，义为「商人；交易者」
由动词加 -ing 构成，义为「交易；买卖」
由 trade 加 mark 合成，义为「商标」

senses.title: The buying and selling of goods
senses.definition: the business of exchanging goods or services between people, companies, or countries
senses.definitionCN: 个人、公司或国家之间交换货物或服务的活动
senses.example: Trade between the two islands stopped during the storm season.
senses.exampleCN: 风暴季期间两座岛之间的贸易中断了。
senses.why: The word first named a track or a beaten path, and trade was the traffic that moved along those paths.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初指一条被踩出来的路线，而贸易正是沿着这些路线流动的往来。

senses.title: A skilled occupation
senses.definition: a kind of work, usually one needing training with the hands, such as carpentry
senses.definitionCN: 一种通常需要手上训练的工作，如木工
senses.example: His trade was that of a wheelwright.
senses.exampleCN: 他的本行是造车轮。
senses.why: Crafts were once practised along particular streets, so the way of making a living took the name of the path.
senses.whyCN: 手艺活儿曾集中在特定街道上经营，于是谋生的方式也沿用了「路」这个名称。

senses.title: A particular branch of business
senses.definition: all the businesses that deal in one kind of goods or service, taken together
senses.definitionCN: 经营同一类商品或服务的所有商家的总称
senses.example: The book trade fears the new tax on paper.
senses.exampleCN: 图书业界担心新的纸张税。
senses.why: When many people share one occupation, the occupation itself becomes a collective body with its own interests.
senses.whyCN: 当许多人从事同一行，这门职业本身就成了有自身利益的集体。

senses.title: To exchange one thing for another
senses.definition: to give something to someone and receive something else in return
senses.definitionCN: 把某物给某人，同时换回另一样东西
senses.example: The boys traded marbles for a football card.
senses.exampleCN: 男孩们用弹珠换了一张足球卡。
senses.why: Any buying and selling is at bottom an exchange, so the noun turns into a simple verb of swapping.
senses.whyCN: 买卖归根到底就是交换，于是名词变成简单的「互换」动词。

senses.title: To deal in goods professionally
senses.definition: to run a business that buys and sells a stated kind of goods
senses.definitionCN: 经营买卖某类特定商品的生意
senses.example: The firm trades in coffee and cocoa.
senses.exampleCN: 这家公司经营咖啡与可可。
senses.why: The verb with in marks the goods that the business lives by, as opposed to goods swapped in passing.
senses.whyCN: 动词后加 in 标记这家生意赖以生存的商品，与随手换东西不同。

senses.title: Swapping one problem for another
senses.definition: in phrases like trade places, to exchange positions or situations with someone
senses.definitionCN: 如 trade places 一类说法中，与某人交换位置或处境
senses.example: For a day the two managers traded places to see the work from below.
senses.exampleCN: 两位经理交换了一天位置，从下面看看这份工作。
senses.why: Once the verb means swap, it can swap anything, including roles that are not goods at all.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这个动词表示互换，它就可以换任何东西，包括根本不是商品的角色。

intro.en: Trade comes from Middle Low German trade, a track or course, and the sense of commerce grew in English from traffic moving along such paths.
intro.cn: trade 来自中古低地德语 trade（路线、轨道），「商业」这一含义是在英语中由沿这些路线往来的货运生长出来的。

items.en: Middle Low German trade means a track, a course, or a beaten way.
items.cn: 中古低地德语 trade 意为路径、走向或踩出来的道。

items.en: English borrows the word in the fourteenth century with the sense of a regular course or way of life.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入这个词，意为惯常的路线或生活方式。

items.en: From the course of travelling merchants come the senses of traffic, commerce, and finally buying and selling between nations.
items.cn: 从商人往来的路线，发展出货运、商业，最后是国与国之间的买卖。

items.en: In the sixteenth century trade also settles into the sense of a skilled craft or occupation.
items.cn: 十六世纪，trade 又固定为指一门需要技艺的行当或职业。

items.en: The verb and phrases such as trade union spread in the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries with industrial growth.
items.cn: 动词用法以及 trade union 一类说法随着工业成长在十八、十九世纪流行开来。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words built on the same trade stem, and the near-meaning group gathers commercial terms.
note.cn: 形近组收集建立在同一 trade 词干上的词，近义组收集商业术语。

the activity of buying and selling
a registered sign of a business
to walk or step
entries.definitionCN: 踩；踏，拼写相近而来源不同

entries.definition: large-scale trade between businesses

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the original sense of a path, from the compounds, and from the verb patterns with in and for.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「路径」这一原义、复合词以及动词后接 in、for 的模式入手。

normal.en: Trade began as a track, so trade is the traffic on that track.
normal.cn: trade 原是「路线」，所以贸易就是这条路线上的人流物流。

normal.en: Trade in coffee means dealing in coffee; trade with a country means doing business with it.
normal.cn: trade in coffee 是经营咖啡，trade with a country 是与某国做生意。

normal.en: Trade union, trade fair, trade mark: in front of a noun the word means belonging to business.
normal.cn: trade union、trade fair、trade mark，放在名词前就表示「属于商业的」。

normal.en: By trade means by occupation, showing the old craft sense.
normal.cn: by trade 意为「就职业而言」，显示古老的「手艺」义项。

normal.en: Trader and trading split the verb into a person and an activity.
normal.cn: trader 与 trading 把这个动词分成人和活动两面。

abstract.en: Picture two hands meeting over a table, one holding a sack, the other coins.
abstract.cn: 想象两只手在桌上相握，一只握着袋子，一只握着硬币。

abstract.en: Think of a road that gets deeper as more carts use it, and the carts are the trade.
abstract.cn: 想一条路越被车轧越深，而那些车就是贸易。

abstract.en: Trade is trust that has been made repeatable.
abstract.cn: 贸易是被做成可重复的信任。

examples.en: The town grew rich on the wool trade.
examples.cn: 这个镇靠羊毛贸易富了起来。

examples.en: By trade he was a carpenter, but he spent his nights writing.
examples.cn: 他本行是木匠，却把夜晚都用来写作。

examples.en: The two children traded hats and laughed.
examples.cn: 两个孩子换着帽子，笑了起来。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「吹得」——生意吹得再大，也是一手交钱一手交货。

root: 中古低地德语 trade（路线、轨道）→ 中古英语 trade（常走的路、生活方式）→ 现代英语 trade（贸易；行业）。词族有 trader、trading、trademark。

sensesIntro.en: The entry starts from a path, turns it into the commerce that travels it, then into the skilled calling practised on it, then into the whole industry, and ends with the verb of swapping anything at all.
sensesIntro.cn: 本词从小路出发，转成沿着它流动的商业，再成为路上经营的行当与整个业界，最后落在一换一切东西的动词上。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: goods and money passing between two hands.
core.cn: 核心意象：货物与钱在两只手之间交换。

branches.en: The commerce that moves along the routes.
The skilled work of a person.
branches.cn: 一个人熟练的谋生手艺。

branches.en: The whole body of that business.
The plain act of swapping, including roles.
branches.cn: 纯粹互换的动作，包括角色。

branches.en: The professional dealing in stated goods.

intro.en: The word is a Low German borrowing with no productive suffix, and its family is built with -er, -ing, and compounds such as mark.
intro.cn: 本词是低地德语借词，没有能产后缀，其词族由 -er、-ing 以及 mark 一类复合成分构成。

latinIntro.en: This word has no Latin source, so no Latin entries are listed; the nearest Latin vocabulary is commercial rather than etymological.
latinIntro.cn: 本词没有拉丁语来源，因此不列拉丁词条；拉丁语中最近的词汇只是意义上的商务用语，并非同源。

items.example: Trade shifted from a path to commerce.
A trader buys and sells.
Trading runs all day on the floor.
items.exampleCN: 交易大厅里全天都在交易。

items.structure: English plural and third person ending
items.example: Trades is both plural and verb form.
items.exampleCN: trades 既是复数也是动词形式。

items.example: A trademark marks a business.
A trade union protects skilled workers.
A trade fair shows new goods.
items.exampleCN: 贸易博览会展示新商品。

items.example: Free trade means open buying and selling.
items.exampleCN: 自由贸易就是开放的买卖。

definition_zh: 传统；惯例；习俗；传承
definition_en: a belief, custom, or way of doing something that has been passed down from one generation to the next
core_image: 一只手把一件老器物递给下一代的手
scene: 除夕夜老人把祖传的木勺交给孩子，让他搅第一下锅里的汤。The family keeps the tradition of cooking the same soup every winter night.
sceneCN: 这里 tradition 是「传统」（第 1 个义项：世代相传的习俗或做法）；句意为这家人保留着每个冬夜煮同样一锅汤的传统。

derivatives.zh: 由名词加 -al 构成形容词，义为「传统的」
由形容词加 -ly 构成，义为「按照传统地」
由形容词加 -ism 构成，义为「传统主义」

senses.title: A custom handed down through generations
senses.definition: a habit or belief that has been passed from older people to younger ones over many years
senses.definitionCN: 由年长者传给年轻一代、延续多年的习惯或信念
senses.example: The tradition of singing at harvest has lasted four centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 丰收时节唱歌的传统已延续了四百年。
senses.why: The Latin verb means to hand over, so a tradition is literally a thing handed from hand to hand.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁动词意为「交出、交付」，所以传统就是一手一手传下来的东西。

senses.title: The body of such customs as a whole
senses.definition: all the customs and beliefs of a people or group considered together
senses.definitionCN: 一个民族或群体的全部习俗与信念的总和
senses.example: He knows the oral tradition of the mountain villages well.
senses.exampleCN: 他对山村的民间传统非常熟悉。
senses.why: Many handings-down pile up into a store, and that store is called the tradition of a people.
senses.whyCN: 许多次传递堆成一个库，这个库就被称为一个民族的传统。

senses.title: A way of working in an art or craft
senses.definition: an established style or method passed on within an art, science, or craft
senses.definitionCN: 在某门艺术、学问或手艺内部沿袭下来的既定风格或方法
senses.example: The painter works in the tradition of the northern landscape schools.
senses.exampleCN: 这位画家属于北方山水流派一脉。
senses.why: Skills are handed down like objects, so a school of art becomes a tradition carried by masters and pupils.
senses.whyCN: 技艺像器物一样被递下去，于是一个艺术流派就成了由师承承担的传统。

senses.title: The act of handing something over
senses.definition: the formal act of passing something into another person's keeping
senses.definitionCN: 把某物正式交到他人手里的行为
senses.example: The tradition of the keys to the new mayor takes place at noon.
senses.exampleCN: 把钥匙交给新市长的仪式在正午举行。
senses.why: This is the oldest legal sense, still visible in the English verb hand over.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的法律含义，在英语 hand over 这一说法里仍能看见。

senses.title: A long-held custom in an institution
senses.definition: an established practice in a school, office, or team that everyone follows
senses.definitionCN: 学校、机关或团队里人人遵循的既定做法
senses.example: It is a tradition here that the newest member makes the tea.
senses.exampleCN: 这里有个惯例：最新来的成员负责泡茶。
senses.why: Small groups create their own handings-down, and the word serves for these everyday customs too.
senses.whyCN: 小群体也会形成自己的传递，这个词同样用于这些日常惯例。

intro.en: Tradition comes from Latin traditio, a handing over, from tradere, to hand across, made of trans-, across, and dare, to give.
intro.cn: tradition 来自拉丁语 traditio（交付），源自 tradere（交过去），由 trans-（穿过）与 dare（给）构成。

items.en: Tradere is built from trans-, across, and dare, to give, and means to hand over or deliver.
items.cn: tradere 由 trans-（穿过）与 dare（给）合成，意为交出、交付。

items.en: Traditio names the act of delivery and, in law, the transfer of property into another's hands.
items.cn: traditio 指交付行为，在法律上指把财产转移到他方手中。

items.en: Old French tradition keeps the sense of handing down teaching and custom.
items.cn: 古法语 tradition 保留了传授教义与习俗的含义。

items.en: English uses tradition first in religious writing for teaching received from the fathers of the church.
items.cn: 英语最先在宗教文献中使用 tradition，指从教父那里接受的教导。

items.en: From the seventeenth century the word widens to any custom or practice inherited from the past.
items.cn: 十七世纪起，这个词扩展到任何从过去继承下来的习俗或做法。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words from the same giving stem, while the near-meaning group gathers customs and inherited practice.
note.cn: 形近组收集同一「给」词根的词，近义组收集习俗与沿袭的做法。

normalIntro.en: These memories work from the giving root, from the family of -al, -ly, and -ism, and from the picture of a handover.
normalIntro.cn: 下面几条从「给」的词根、由 -al、-ly、-ism 构成的词族以及「递交」的画面入手。

normal.en: Trans- plus dare: give across. A tradition is what gets given across the years.
normal.cn: trans- 加 dare，就是「给过去」。传统就是被给过岁月的那些东西。

normal.en: The same root gives traitor and betray, because to hand someone over is also to betray.
normal.cn: 同一词根给出 traitor 与 betray，因为把人交出去也就是出卖。

normal.en: Traditional adds -al, traditionally adds -ly, traditionalism adds -ism.
normal.cn: traditional 加 -al，traditionally 加 -ly，traditionalism 加 -ism。

normal.en: Break with tradition and keep the tradition are opposites in one phrase family.
normal.cn: break with tradition 与 keep the tradition 是同一搭配族里的对立面。

normal.en: The word ends in -tion, so it names the thing and the act of handing down at once.
normal.cn: 本词以 -tion 结尾，同时指被传下来的东西与传递这一行为。

abstract.en: Picture an old wooden spoon passed from a grandmother's hand to a grandchild's.
abstract.cn: 想象一把旧木勺从祖母的手递到孙辈的手里。

abstract.en: Think of a path worn by many feet over centuries, still visible under fresh grass.
abstract.cn: 想一条被几百年脚步踩出的路，如今仍在新草下隐约可见。

abstract.en: A tradition is a choice that has already been made many times before you make it.
abstract.cn: 传统是一个在你做出之前就已经被做过许多次的选择。

examples.en: It is a tradition to eat dumplings on New Year's Eve.
examples.cn: 除夕吃饺子是一项传统。

examples.en: The village has kept its fishing traditions for many centuries.
examples.cn: 这个村子把捕鱼传统保留了许多个世纪。

examples.en: By tradition the eldest son lights the first lamp.
examples.cn: 按照传统，由长子点亮第一盏灯。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「穿递什」——一代人穿过时间把手里的东西递交给下一代。

root: 拉丁语 trans-（穿过）+ dare（给）→ tradere（交付）→ traditio（交付、传交）→ 古法语 tradition → 英语 tradition。同源词有 traitor、betray、tradition（教义传承义）。

sensesIntro.en: The root means a handover, so the entry begins with the custom handed down, gathers such handovers into a people's whole store, narrows to the school of an art, returns to the bare legal handover, and ends with the small customs of an institution.
sensesIntro.cn: 词根意为「递交」，因此本词先指被递下来的习俗，再把递交聚成一个民族的全部家底，收窄为艺术流派，回到纯粹的法律交付，最后落在团体内部的小惯例。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thing passed from an older hand into a younger one.
core.cn: 核心意象：一件东西从年长的手递进年轻的手。

branches.cn: 艺术或手艺内部的传承体系。

branches.en: The bare act of delivery in law.
branches.cn: 法律上纯粹的交付行为。

branches.en: The small habit of a group.

intro.en: The word rests on the Latin verb dare, to give, with the prefix trans- and the noun ending -tio; English adds -al, -ly, and -ism.
intro.cn: 本词建立在拉丁语动词 dare（给）之上，配前缀 trans- 与名词词尾 -tio；英语再加 -al、-ly、-ism。

latinIntro.en: The Latin entries below show the giving verb and the handing-over noun behind this word.
latinIntro.cn: 下面的拉丁词条给出本词背后的「给」动词与「交付」名词。

items.example: Dare is the core verb of the family.
items.exampleCN: dare 是这个词族的核心动词。

items.example: Trans- turns giving into giving across.
Tradition is the handing down and what is handed down.
items.exampleCN: tradition 既是传递行为也是传递之物。

items.example: Traditional means relating to tradition.
items.exampleCN: traditional 意为与传统相关的。

items.example: Traditionally adds the adverb ending.
Traditionalism values the old ways.
A traditionalist follows old customs.
Traitor keeps the older sense of handing over.
items.exampleCN: traitor 保留了「交出」的旧义。
